ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The table in the figure has three experiments, with columns Trial, [NO]init (M), [Br2]init (M), Initial Rate of Reaction (M/min). Trial 1: [NO]=0.20 M, [Br2]=0.10 M, rate=5.20×10^-3 M/min. Trial 2: [NO]=0.20 M, [Br2]=0.20 M, rate=1.04×10^-2 M/min. Trial 3: [NO]=0.40 M, [Br2]=0.10 M, rate=2.08×10^-2 M/min. Reasoning: Let the rate equation be rate = k[NO]^m[Br2]^n. Comparing experiments 1 and 2, [NO] remains unchanged at 0.20 M, [Br2] doubles from 0.10 M to 0.20 M, and the reaction rate also doubles from 5.20×10^-3 to 1.04×10^-2, therefore it is first order with respect to Br2, n=1. Comparing experiments 1 and 3, [Br2] remains unchanged at 0.10 M, [NO] doubles from 0.20 M to 0.40 M, and the reaction rate changes from 5.20×10^-3 to 2.08×10^-2, that is, it becomes 4 times, therefore it is second order with respect to NO, m=2. So the rate equation is rate = k[NO]^2[Br2].

raw_record.question_text: The above experiment was performed several times, and the data was gathered as shown in the figure. What is the rate law for this reaction?

method.method_draft: First describe/read the table, then assume rate=k[NO]^m[Br2]^n. Compare Trials 1 and 2: [NO] is constant at 0.20 M, [Br2] doubles from 0.10 to 0.20 M, and the rate doubles from 5.20×10^-3 to 1.04×10^-2 M/min, so n=1. Compare Trials 1 and 3: [Br2] is constant at 0.10 M, [NO] doubles from 0.20 to 0.40 M, and the rate quadruples from 5.20×10^-3 to 2.08×10^-2 M/min, so m=2. Therefore write the rate law as rate=k[NO]^2[Br2].

推理：设速率方程为 rate = k[NO]^m[Br2]^n。比较实验1和2，[NO]保持0.20 M不变，[Br2]从0.10 M加倍到0.20 M，反应速率也从5.20×10^-3加倍到1.04×10^-2，因此对Br2为一级，n=1。比较实验1和3，[Br2]保持0.10 M不变，[NO]从0.20 M加倍到0.40 M，反应速率从5.20×10^-3变为2.08×10^-2，即变为4倍，因此对NO为二级，m=2。所以速率方程为 rate = k[NO]^2[Br2]。
